20260522-183924-biological-cell-8f264fc5.seed_text: Cell Membrane with Moving Ion Channels: A large transparent sphere acts as a cell membrane with colored “ion channel” cylinders that open and close, letting small charged spheres drift through, bounce, and leave trails while a simple meter shows inside vs. outside ion counts.

Cell Division (Mitosis) Animation: A single cell sphere with a central duplicated chromosome cluster stretches, forms spindle fibers (thin rods) that pull chromosome spheres apart, and the whole cell pinches into two daughter cells that detach and drift slightly apart.

3D Cell with Organelles and Cytoplasmic Flow: A semi-transparent cell sphere contains a nucleus, mitochondria, vesicles, and ribosomes, where vesicles float along curved paths, gently collide and bounce off organelles, and leave faint trails while labels hover over each structure.
